notes: Go only. Warden, a Go port of DevMortimer's pi-warden (Ryan Gapac, MIT): irreversible tool calls held before they run, off-task calls flagged, stuck loops and unverified done claims called out. Run npm run stage before using its generated manifest under dist/staged.

Opt-in: it does nothing until /warden enable, which shows what would leave the machine and asks which judge to use: TypeSafe Jev, your own session model, or offline patterns only. The warden Package also installs on its own with pig install and shares the typesafe client library Package.

A Piglet Binary builds locally from the staged manifest with PIG_SOURCE_ROOT set to a git checkout of the PiG source. Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release pig-warden/v0.1.1 (built natively by the release workflow; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-warden@0.1.1); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and no platform is a support claim.
